delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
delete.hideHint: To stop selling it for now, set its status to Hidden instead.

form.subtitle: Customers only see products that are Active.

slug.label: URL slug
slug.hint: Generated from the name. If taken, -2, -3… is added.

description.label: Description (optional)
description.hint: Line breaks are kept. HTML tags show as plain text.

compareAtPrice.label: Compare-at price (₫) (optional)
compareAtPrice.hint: Leave empty if there's no discount. With a compare-at price, customers see it struck through with the percentage off.

status.hint: Hidden: customers can't see the product and its page returns 404.

availability.hint: Out-of-stock products still show in the customer list.

errors.nameTooLong: Name must be 150 characters or fewer
errors.slugFormat: Use lowercase a–z, digits and hyphens only, with no hyphen at the start or end.
errors.slugTooLong: Slug must be 100 characters or fewer
errors.slugTaken: This slug is already in use
errors.slugNotGenerated: Every slug made from this name is taken. Type a slug yourself.
errors.descriptionTooLong: Description must be 5,000 characters or fewer
errors.priceWhole: Price must be a whole number of đồng
errors.priceInvalid: Enter the price as a number, like 250.000
errors.compareAtPriceGreater: Compare-at price must be greater than the price
